root_cause.text: The functions __kvm_at_s12() and __kvm_find_s1_desc_level() call page table walkers (walk_s1() and kvm_walk_nested_s2()) that require the kvm->srcu lock to protect against concurrent memslot modifications, but they fail to acquire the SRCU lock before invoking those walkers, leading to a potential race condition.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states that "walk_s1() and kvm_walk_nested_s2() expect to be called while holding kvm->srcu to guard against memslot changes" and that "__kvm_at_s12() and __kvm_find_s1_desc_level() call into the respective walkers without taking kvm->srcu." The patch adds `scoped_guard(srcu, &vcpu->kvm->srcu)` around both calls to remedy this.

Checks return value of the unprotected walk; if memslots change during the walk, the error handling may be based on inconsistent state.
Returns the result of the unprotected walk; the returned value may be invalid if a memslot update occurred in parallel.

Switches on the result of the unprotected walk; the behavior depends on potentially corrupted return value due to missing SRCU protection.
